notes: The default targets of the play pattern continuous for a game whose designer does not answer (Existing game, step 3; Design forward, step 2). Copy this file and keep its values.
No demo end: a demo end is a decision of the designer. Add targets.demo_end only when the request names a demo.
length_h is the length to the hard end: 6 active hours, inside the default band 3 to 6 hours (SG:177-178).

purchase_gap: the largest gap between purchases is at most 2 minutes, and the first purchase comes inside 2 minutes (SG:180-181). The unlock gap targets 10 and 5 minutes are designer targets with no source (CT6, CT7).

The unlock counts follow from the gap targets (references/interview.md, A1.3 and A1.4): the first-hour gap of 5 minutes needs ceil(60 / 5) - 1 = 11 unlocks or more in the first hour (pw_design.first_hour_band), and the gap of 10 minutes needs ceil(60 / 10) - 1 = 5 unlocks or more in each later hour. No source counts unlocks (SG:198), so the record marks them unsupported.
The active factor is x1.25, the sourced value of S05.active_lane (TB:61, TA:507). The play-test speed has no source in the short games (SG:204): it is a designer target, not supported by a source.
